description: Get an enriched company profile by ticker symbol. Returns CIK, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, employee count, description, and other fundamental data in a lightweight response. Includes halted/haltCode/haltedAt trading-halt status on every call (false/null when trading normally); a halted-but-listed ticker reports delisted:false. `sharesOutstanding` is dated: `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" = the issuer's statement date; "checked" = when it was last confirmed against a vendor; "none" = date not recorded) and a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource`. The count is only meaningful with its date. A null count means not measured; it does not mean zero. `cik: null` is a foreign issuer listed on US OTC that files nothing with the SEC (e.g. PGPHF): name, exchange and country come from reference data and every field Signal8 lacks is null.
name: get_company_profile
title: Get Company Profile
